title: Logger Rate Limiter
goal: Track the last accepted timestamp per message so each independent message can be printed again only after the time window expires.
strategy: Remember the last accepted timestamp for each message and allow it again only after its suppression interval has elapsed.
edgeCases: Different messages have independent timers; the exact interval boundary is accepted.
inputRules: each request must be an object { "timestamp": number, "message": string }
threshold must be a non-negative number
